$comment: Forge AI evaluation set (crew redesign Release 2, owner priority 'AI model improvements'). Realistic crew requests in English, Spanish, mixed and noisy voice-style transcripts, each with the checklist/receipt outcome the tool layer must produce. `stub` is the tool trajectory a well-behaved model takes: `node --experimental-strip-types scripts/ask-eval.mjs` replays it through the real registry, executors and receipt guard with no model at all; `--live` sends only `utterance` to a real model and scores what it actually did. Synthetic jobs and people only (scripts/ask-eval.mjs builds the world).
